text: Refining D-0198 after #349's review: a backing test supports its contract only when some result tests it and no result reports it unsuccessful, so one failed, skipped or unexercised run vetoes another's pass, and a conflicting_support diagnostic says so. Two contracts can't bind one operation however a manifest splits its dotted name, or whichever kind or distribution it names; a declaration can't be both one contract's abstraction and another's operation; and every component path must be spelled exactly as its directory lists it, so a case-insensitive disk can't give one file two identities. Stale evidence of every kind carries ErrStaleComponentEvidence: a known declaration, file or invocation whose contents changed, and a retained record whose anchors did. An unaccounted boundary names its operation in the inventory's own form and can't name one a declared contract binds, and an assumed contract's declaration must be among the attempt's inputs. Receipts derive each proof's status again from its own result, and show a proof's unaccounted boundaries in a report without contracts.
